images.prompt: Premium editorial illustration, high-end tech magazine style: a vast empty steel building frame at night, all exposed girders and open sky, unlit and skeletal, receding upward - and at its base one small completed room glowing warm cream (#F4EFE3) from within, the only occupied space in the entire structure. Deep dark navy (#161a45) dominant palette, soft cream (#F4EFE3) as the only light source, with a single thin red (#eb2027) accent line at the base of the lit room. Cinematic moody lighting, minimalist composition. Full-bleed edge-to-edge artwork. No text, no numbers, no letterforms, no logos, no signage.

notes: Text-free hero, so it carries both the Spanish (2 PM) and English (4 PM) posts. Approved on the first roll -- the two guards carried over from the Sep 14 hero both worked: pinning cream and explicitly excluding blue prevented the cyan drift, and specifying exactly one non-traveling red element prevented the fragmented/forked red path. Architectural scenes invite signage; checked and clean.
